'''Furran''', sometimes known as '''Furran of the Intari''', was a [[Filordus]] individual who worked as a [[permitor]] in [[Depatar/Legends|Depatar]]. He was associated with the [[House Intari]],<ref name="Clouded Paths" /> and had a name that was common for the Filordus [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> As Filordi were considered unusual by many other species, Furran had fewer job opportunities than other permitors, and the ongoing disappointments led to him often seeming angry and gruff with other beings.<ref name="Clouded Paths" />

{{RPG|''[[Clouds of Genarius: Clouded Paths|Clouded Paths]]''}}
At some point, Furran made contact via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] with visitors landing in a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], hoping to be hired as a permitor by the visitors. Other prospectives included [[Gusimin]] the Honest, [[Koyi Kobad]], [[Maltok (Trandoshan)|Maltok]], and [[Sadana]]. Furran and the other permitors were disappointed to discover that the visitors had already hired [[Fot Ducela]].<ref name="Clouded Paths" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Furran is referred to with he/him pronouns in ''[[Clouds of Genarius: Clouded Paths|Clouded Paths]]'' and does not have a specified [[Gender/Legends|gender]].<ref name="Clouded Paths" /> {{LivingForce|Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast}} clarified that the Filordus species does not have genders and Filordi are not gendered individuals, but used he/him pronouns for [[Rikard (Filordus)|Rikard]] with a note that "any gendered pronouns that we use are simply for convenience."<ref name="Belly of the Beaast">{{LivingForce|Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast}}</ref> It is unclear if Furran is similarly referred to as he/him for the reader's convenience.
